lines.en: I mean, I've got it narrowed down to two people.
One of them has great references and a lot of experience.
He's so pretty. I want to cry.
I don't know what to do. Tell me what to do.
Come on, you know what to do. You hire the first one.
You don't hire an assistant because they're cute.
You hire them because they're qualified.
No, I hear what you're saying, and that makes a lot of sense.
But can I just say one more thing?
No, you can't hire him because it's not professional.
Um, this is for me, yes?
and don't tell her about the wow.
